text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It has been raining endlessly for days 
now. Deciding to do indoor training today 
as well, I visited the gym storage room, 
only to find—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Indoor training again today, huh. 
I wonder when the skies will finally clear 
up~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho... Just a little more patience, I 
should think...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Heaven and earth endure long—rising from 
the soil... dripping from the skies... and 
flowing back into the earth, such is the 
natural destiny of rainfall...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I'm sure it'll stop soon enough. 
Let's do our best today too, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though they seemed a bit disappointed, the 
girls carried on with their indoor 
training—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: CHOWAAA--TT!! The sunlight is back!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ——!! It's sunny outside...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now that it has come to this, we cannot 
idly jump rope a moment longer! Onward, 
BAKUSHIII---N!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two raced out under the clear blue 
sky. Relieved, I watched them go, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Well then... shall we resume our 
training—Laurel-san...?
choice_data_list: Huh? Aren't you two going outside?

Huh? Aren't you two going outside with 
them?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah—Trainer-san. Thank you for checking on 
us. But as for us... right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
The reason heaven and earth can endure so 
long... is that they do not live for 
themselves—and thus...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. How should I put it... We're just a 
little different from Baku-chan and 
Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If we try to force ourselves to do too 
much, we only end up taking the long way 
around.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So, we thought we'd stick to the plan and 
finish our indoor training today. 
...Without rushing, just riding along with 
the river's gentle current.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I've heard both of 
them were prone to falling ill ever since 
they were young...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Besides—seeing others off... has been our 
destined role since our youth...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
We are the perches... Until the birds take 
flight and return, we shall train right 
here... at our own gentle pace...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, the sun began to set—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am hooooome! Bakushiiin! As expected, 
going outside was simply magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... hohoho... You two certainly 
brought back quite a lively cloud of 
dust...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh...?! Wah, I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, let's dust off first♪ After that, 
how about taking a break—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Wait just a moment... It appears the dust 
has settled onto you as well, 
Laurel-san... Please stay right there, 
perfectly still—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! Wah, you're right...! Thank you, 
Chitose-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all... Seeing everyone so full of 
energy is truly a wonderful thing... 
hohoho...
